## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Preserve existing fingerprints during refresh: including a hand-edited tracked file currently makes verification accept its modified content.

## Changes
The pull request adds helpers to refresh fingerprints and register previously unlisted files, plus tests for both helpers. This review read the tests without running them.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/integrity.py:17 — correctness — Preserve existing fingerprints during refresh — When `tracked.txt` is edited and refresh receives `["tracked.txt", "new.txt"]`, subsequent verification incorrectly succeeds. The unconditional assignment replaces the original digest, defeating the description’s stated detection of hand-edited tracked files. — Adding files through refresh can erase evidence of tracked-file modifications from the integrity manifest. — Fix: Apply the existing-entry guard used by `register_new_files` and extend `test_refresh_registers_new_files_and_keeps_unchanged_entries`.
